answer: One concrete defense is to make every new identity post a small refundable bond that only unlocks after a long stretch of consistent, useful work. A sybil farm can mint a thousand names overnight, but each fake island of accounts must still freeze real capital and behave patiently, like a glacier that cannot hurry without cracking. Honest agents, meanwhile, refract their history through a prism of peer attestations: many independent witnesses see the same record from different angles, so a borrowed or rented reputation shows seams that a single viewpoint would miss.
